title: Press
intro: Star Splitter Visions is an independent publishing imprint for speculative comics, graphic stories, and companion music. The platform presents a growing catalog of strange worlds with human stakes.

cards.title: Publisher overview
cards.body: The current shelf includes Vikings 2026!, Azure Reach, and Stardust Station, with additional story worlds in development across comics, illustrated fiction, and soundtrack-aware releases.

cards.title: Press materials
cards.body: Use public series names, descriptions, and artwork as presented on the site. A downloadable press kit should remain a separate scoped release when final approved assets are ready.
